requirement:
The authoring harness MUST use Rig and support Bedrock, Ollama, and OpenAI. Users MUST be
able to select a backend and model through configuration without changing the
assessment tools, prompt, or evidence format.
rationale:
`requirements.authoring.provider` is satisfied.

The obligations and their coverage are:

- **Use Rig.** `src/authoring/providers.rs#struct[RigProvider]` stores a backend-erased Rig `DynModel<Completion>`. `src/authoring/providers.rs#impl[RigProvider]/fn[connect]` constructs Rig clients for all three backends, and `src/authoring/providers.rs#impl[RigProvider/CompletionProvider]` sends completion requests through that model. The referenced integration test `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[all_adapters_preserve_prompt_tools_and_evidence_with_default_connections]` exercises these clients against local servers.
- **Support Bedrock, Ollama, and OpenAI** (three obligations). `connect` explicitly handles each `BackendConfig` variant using the respective Rig adapter. The all-adapters test completes an assessment with each backend and checks its outgoing requests and resulting evidence. Additional coverage comes from `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[bedrock_cli_uses_selected_profile_region_and_converse_tools]` and `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[openai_responses_replays_tool_calls_and_records_usage]`, which exercise source-tool calls and submission across multiple requests.
- **Allow configuration to select a backend and a model** (two obligations). `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[configured_record]` passes the resolved backend configuration to `connect`; `connect` selects the adapter and supplies the configured model to it. The all-adapters test writes backend/model configurations and asserts the model in each resulting HTTP request (including Bedrock's model URL). `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[authoring_uses_nearest_workspace_configuration_without_a_user_file]` additionally verifies a workspace-selected Ollama model.
- **Require no changes to assessment tools, prompt, or evidence format when selecting backend/model** (three obligations). `configured_record` passes every connected provider into the same `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[assess_subject]` and `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[assess]` pipeline. `assess` constructs the prompt, runs the conversation, and builds the evidence independently of backend selection. The all-adapters test explicitly compares the prompts and complete sorted tool definitions across all three backends, using `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[prompt_and_tools]` to remove only transport envelopes. It also asserts equality of the entire evidence documents, including inputs and reference hashes.

All of these implementation paths are reachable from the subject's marked `configured_record` root. The tests above carry references to the subject; their equality assertions directly cover the required unchanged properties. No gap was found.
